description: This file implements security-related functionalities for the API backend, including password hashing, verification, and JWT token creation and decoding. It interacts with configuration settings to retrieve secrets and expiration durations.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plain-text password using bcrypt via passlib.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plain-text password against a stored bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, role: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with user ID, role, and optional expiration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT access token, raising errors if invalid or expired.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, role: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, role: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
